title: CYUKTI Experiment Record
description: One reproducible record of a real (or explicitly-marked synthetic) scenario run through CYUKTI, from raw Wazuh alert through the MISP publication decision. See experiments/README.md.

timestamp.description: When the scenario was actually run, ISO 8601, real wall-clock time -- never backfilled.

data_provenance.description: real_live_environment: every field below was observed from a real running system. synthetic_reconstruction: inputs are real but some downstream fields were reconstructed/estimated rather than freshly re-observed live -- must say which fields and why. unit_test_fixture: entirely synthetic, for testing the recording mechanism itself only -- must never be cited as evidence of system behavior.

attacker.description: Real attacker IP/host, or null if the scenario has none (e.g. a benign informational alert).

scenario.description: One-line description of what was actually done (e.g. 'nmap -sV -O scan against target').

input.description: The real raw input(s) to the pipeline -- at minimum the actual Wazuh alert JSON(s), verbatim.

expected_behavior.description: What the experimenter predicted CYUKTI would do, written BEFORE observing actual_behavior.

actual_behavior.description: What CYUKTI actually did, written from direct observation (log lines, API responses, DB queries) -- never inferred or assumed.

evidence.description: Real Evidence.to_dict() records, if an investigation was run for this scenario. null if no investigation was run.

note.description: e.g. 'Execution unavailable -- SHUFFLE_WEBHOOK not configured' when no real execution occurred.

latency.description: Real measured latencies for this specific run, in ms, per stage -- not a benchmark-harness average. null if not measured for this run.

errors.description: Any errors/exceptions/degraded states actually observed during this run -- empty array if genuinely none, never omitted.
